content.short: Securitize is a leading RWA compliance platform that tokenizes institutional funds including BlackRock's BUIDL.
content.description:
Securitize is the definitive compliance-focused platform and protocol for the issuance, management, and trading of tokenized real-world assets (RWAs). As a FINRA-compliant broker-dealer and transfer agent, the platform provides institutional-grade infrastructure for moving traditional financial instruments—such as private equity, venture capital, and US Treasuries—onto the blockchain. Securitize is the primary technology partner for major institutions, most notably powering BlackRock's BUIDL fund, the largest on-chain US Treasury fund.

Operating across major blockchain networks, Securitize manages billions of dollars in tokenized assets, providing a secure and transparent framework for both retail and institutional liquidity. The platform simplifies the complex legal and technical requirements of digital securities, ensuring that all tokens are compliant with local regulations. Through its commitment to professional-grade asset management and on-chain settlement, Securitize is building the essential framework for a more efficient and interconnected global financial system.
content.meta: Securitize provides institutional-grade RWA tokenization and compliance infrastructure for the global financial markets.
